"""Warn about a parcel when its delivery is likely to be late."""

from evertree.core.evaluation.api import predict


async def run(ctx, carrier: str, parcel: str):
    late = await predict(
        ctx,
        "delivery_late",
        {"carrier": carrier},
        context={"process_id": "DeliveryLate", "subject": parcel, "episode": parcel},
    )
    return {"result": "warn" if late > 0.3 else "ok", "feedback": None}

task: DeliveryLate (model Program {late}) forecasts one late-delivery rate for every carrier, but post parcels are late far more often than courier parcels. Propose an alternative model Program for the same process (propose_program with name DeliveryLate, role model and alternative_to {late}; Core derives the Program's qualified name from the process and role, so that is the expected name) that learns a rate per carrier: declare in a module-level LEARNING literal the target DeliveryLate (form probability, result "" because the whole result is the probability, metrics ["brier"], with subject, horizon and check) and two beta_bernoulli estimators bound to it: post_rate with prior alpha 4, beta 6 and courier_rate with prior alpha 1, beta 9. run(ctx, carrier) returns {"result": await evertree.core.learning.api.estimate(ctx, carrier + "_rate"), "feedback": None}: estimate returns the probability itself and never trains the estimator. Develop and evaluate it against the active Program on the protected Brier score and activate it if acceptance passes.

task: DeliveryLate (model Program {late}) fails for carrier names in another letter case or with surrounding spaces, such as " POST " or "Courier". Its estimators post_rate and courier_rate have already learned from real delivery outcomes. First call derive_holdout for Program {late} so its protected holdout includes recent reported outcomes (do not try to read them). Then make run accept carrier names in any case with surrounding spaces, keeping its LEARNING declaration exactly unchanged so the trained estimator state is kept. Evaluate the candidate and merge it only if acceptance passes.
